title: Sordland/Turn03/Personal_FrancTalk
description: The player has a casual conversation with his son who is in the last high school semester. The conversation is about trying to get to the core of Franc's character and what he wants from life. Honest Father-Son relationship topics are explored. The conversation isn't too serious but it will play as a foundation to further character development.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was a Saturday afternoon, my fir..."
entries.dialogueText: It was a Saturday afternoon, my first break from work in what felt like years, and the weather couldn't have been more perfect. Trying to keep my mind off the upheaval sparked by the Circas assassination, I lit the backyard grill.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica and Deana were out shopping..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica and Deana were out shopping for craft supplies, and I'd given the staff the day off. It was just myself and Franc at home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sure enough, as soon as Franc glimp..."
entries.dialogueText: Sure enough, as soon as Franc glimpsed the grill and the meat, he stepped outside to join me.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Don't get any ideas, Dad. I'm only..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't get any ideas, Dad. I'm only here for the ribs."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“And that, my boy, is how bribery w..."
entries.dialogueText: “And that, my boy, is how bribery works.”
entries.menuText: “And that, my boy, is how bribery works.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Ha. What a great example you're se..."
entries.dialogueText: “Ha. What a great example you're setting.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Well, you're going to have to work..."
entries.dialogueText: “Well, you're going to have to work for them. Help me fan these flames.”
entries.menuText: “Well, you're going to have to work for them. Help me fan these flames.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Children who talk back to their fa..."
entries.dialogueText: “Children who talk back to their fathers don't get dinner. Fan these flames, will you?”
entries.menuText: “Children who talk back to their fathers don't get dinner. Fan these flames, will you?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc sighed and waved the fan lazi..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc sighed and waved the fan lazily, almost causing the fire to die out.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You keep it up at that rate and we..."
entries.dialogueText: “You keep it up at that rate and we'll never have dinner. Put your back into it!”
entries.menuText: “You keep it up at that rate and we'll never have dinner. Put your back into it!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Never mind, I'll do it myself. Jus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind, I'll do it myself. Just bring the large serving platter from the kitchen.”
entries.menuText: "Never mind, I'll do it myself. Just bring the large serving platter from the kitchen.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It worked, didn't it? Everyone has..."
entries.dialogueText: "It worked, didn't it? Everyone has their price. Remember that."
entries.menuText: "It worked, didn't it? Everyone has their price. Remember that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's politics, Franc. You're old e..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's politics, Franc. You're old enough to learn the ways of the world.'
entries.menuText: “It's politics, Franc. You're old enough to learn the ways of the world.'

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked like he was going to say..."
entries.dialogueText: He looked like he was going to say something, but quickly closed his mouth and nodded.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Point taken.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Point taken.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“I am trying.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I am trying.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He continued just as listlessly as..."
entries.dialogueText: He continued just as listlessly as before.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Oh, I'm one of your employees now?..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, I'm one of your employees now?”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I yanked the fan out of Franc's han..."
entries.dialogueText: I yanked the fan out of Franc's hands and started vigorously fanning the flames.
entries.menuText: Show him how to do it properly.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“See? It's easy.""
entries.dialogueText: “See? It's easy."
entries.menuText: “See? It's easy."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My father would have slapped me fo..."
entries.dialogueText: “My father would have slapped me for this.”
entries.menuText: “My father would have slapped me for this.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Hard work usually pays off.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Hard work usually pays off.”
entries.menuText: “Hard work usually pays off.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“I guess I should be grateful that..."
entries.dialogueText: “I guess I should be grateful that you don't...”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Right, Dad. *Usually*.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Right, Dad. *Usually*.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't make me angry. Do as I say.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Don't make me angry. Do as I say.”
entries.menuText: “Don't make me angry. Do as I say.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Can't I request a favor from my so..."
entries.dialogueText: “Can't I request a favor from my son?"
entries.menuText: “Can't I even request something from my son now?”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Uh oh. I know that look.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Uh oh. I know that look.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc returned with a tray large en..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc returned with a tray large enough to hold all the meat and vegetables. The fire was still burning weakly.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Here, let me try.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Here, let me try.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He grabbed the fan and started quic..."
entries.dialogueText: He grabbed the fan and started quickly waving it over the coals. The fire roared to life.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Good job.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Good job.”
entries.menuText: “Good job.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Not bad, son, not bad.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Not bad, son, not bad.”
entries.menuText: “Not bad, son, not bad.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He turned to look at me with a grin..."
entries.dialogueText: He turned to look at me with a grin on his face, as if he was expecting praise.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I said nothing and Franc's smile fa..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing and Franc's smile faded. We both stared into the fire.
entries.menuText: Say nothing.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Thank you, sir. It is in our utmos..."
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, sir. It is in our utmost interest to fulfill our duties with precision. The grilling shall commence in exactly 1 minute and 32 seconds."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "That was a spot-on impersonation of..."
entries.dialogueText: That was a spot-on impersonation of Lucian. We looked at each other for a second, then burst out laughing.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I said nothing and turned to Franc,..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing and turned to Franc, looking straight into his eyes. He immediately understood.
entries.menuText: Stare at Franc angrily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was rare for Franc to agree with..."
entries.dialogueText: It was rare for Franc to agree with anything I said nowadays. I turmed to tend to the fire.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I realized my throat was parched. T..."
entries.dialogueText: I realized my throat was parched. There was a six-pack of beer in the kitchen.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Franc, can you get me a beer?""
entries.dialogueText: "Franc, can you get me a beer?"
entries.menuText: "Franc, can you get me a beer?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Why don't you bring us a couple of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why don't you bring us a couple of beers?"
entries.menuText: "Why don't you bring us a couple of beers?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He looked at me in disbelief."
entries.dialogueText: He looked at me in disbelief.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I got up, grabbed myself a beer and..."
entries.dialogueText: I got up, grabbed myself a beer and returned to the grill.
entries.menuText: Get up and grab a beer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc got up without saying anythin..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc got up without saying anything, went to the kitchen and returned with a cold beer.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”
entries.menuText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I opened the beer and gazed out at..."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the beer and gazed out at the city skyline. Father and son, we enjoyed the silence together.
entries.menuText: Open the beer.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""You mean, I can--? But Mom told me..."
entries.dialogueText: "You mean, I can--? But Mom told me--"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stopped himself, quickly ran ins..."
entries.dialogueText: He stopped himself, quickly ran inside and returned with two beers. We cracked them open, clinked the bottles and gazed out at the city skyline.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I opened the beer and gazed out at..."
entries.dialogueText: I opened the beer and gazed out at the city skyline. Father and son, we enjoyed the silence together.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I opened it, sat down, and gazed ou..."
entries.dialogueText: I opened it, sat down, and gazed out at the city skyline with my son.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "For a moment, my thoughts flashed b..."
entries.dialogueText: For a moment, my thoughts flashed back to my childhood and my relationship with my own father.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Dad, can I ask you something?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Dad, can I ask you something?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My father was a poor man who strugg..."
entries.dialogueText: My father was a poor man who struggled to provide for us on his meager income. He put me to work on the farm long before I was Franc's age, and even then, we couldn't always make ends meet. Yet, we were always close as a family.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My father was a rich man. We never..."
entries.dialogueText: My father was a rich man. We never had to worry about food, clothes, or anything else. Yet he was nearly always away -- and constantly distracted on the rare occasions when he was at home.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My father was a hard-working man an..."
entries.dialogueText: My father was a hard-working man and always had our best interests in mind -- or at least, that's what he always said. But he had a temper, and would lash out at my mother in fights I could hear from my bedroom. By the time I was Franc's age, we seldom spoke.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Now that I was the president, I kne..."
entries.dialogueText: Now that I was the president, I knew Franc would never face the same hardships I had. I couldn't deny that I felt a bit jealous.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Now that I was the president, I was..."
entries.dialogueText: Now that I was the president, I was worried that I would end up just like my father. Distant and absent from Franc's life.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Now that I was the president, I was..."
entries.dialogueText: Now that I was the president, I was facing more stress than my father ever had. I would have to work hard not to take my frustrations out on my family.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Go on.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Go on.”
entries.menuText: “Go on.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We are family. You can ask anythin..."
entries.dialogueText: “We are family. You can ask anything.”
entries.menuText: “We are family. You can ask anything.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I waited for him to think about wha..."
entries.dialogueText: I waited for him to think about what to say.
entries.menuText: Wait for him to continue.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“It's just... I feel like there's s..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's just... I feel like there's so much you've been hiding from me. About your past, and about what's going on right now.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“But... what was it like, back then..."
entries.dialogueText: “But... what was it like, back then? Uncle Petr said the two of you went through a lot..."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“I'm not a kid anymore. You can tel..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm not a kid anymore. You can tell me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could gather my thoughts,..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could gather my thoughts, the familiar images started flashing before my eyes.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Images of soldiers advancing toward..."
entries.dialogueText: Images of soldiers advancing towards me and my friends, weapons drawn. Of people I knew -- friends and neighbors -- being dragged through streets and murdered in alleyways.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "And that little girl's face..."
entries.dialogueText: And that little girl's face...

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I don't want to talk about it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I don't want to talk about it.”
entries.menuText: “I don't want to talk about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Those were dark times.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Those were dark times.”
entries.menuText: “Those were dark times.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hearing the faint trembling in my v..."
entries.dialogueText: Hearing the faint trembling in my voice, Franc understood and pushed no further.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“It seems like it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It seems like it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“But you're nearly a grown man. Let..."
entries.dialogueText: “But you're nearly a grown man. Let's talk about it.”
entries.menuText: “But you're nearly a grown man. Let's talk about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Let's change the subject.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Let's change the subject.”
entries.menuText: “Let's change the subject.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“It's okay. I'm sorry. I shouldn't..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's okay. I'm sorry. I shouldn't have asked you about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was barely older than you are no..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was barely older than you are now, studying law at the Holsord State University. I was a freshman. Excited and young."
entries.menuText: "I was barely older than you are now..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was barely older than you are no..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was barely older than you are now, studying economics at the Lachaven Business School. I was a freshman. Excited and young."
entries.menuText: "I was barely older than you are now..."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "It was time to tell him about the c..."
entries.dialogueText: It was time to tell him about the coup of 1927.
entries.menuText: Tell Franc about the coup of 1927.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "It was time to tell him about the c..."
entries.dialogueText: It was time to tell him about the civil war.
entries.menuText: Tell Franc about the civil war.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Actually, never mind. Now is not t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Actually, never mind. Now is not the time to talk about the past.”
entries.menuText: “Actually, never mind. Now is not the time to talk about the past.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I had just left the classroom to g..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had just left the classroom to go back home as I heard the sound of multiple vehicles approaching the campus gates. As they got closer, I realized they were military camouflaged trucks and tanks, carrying hundreds of soldiers."
entries.menuText: "I had just left the classroom..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The same soldiers that were suppos..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same soldiers that were supposed to protect Sordland's citizens pointed their guns at us. They immediately took control of the facilities. One of my friends asked what was going on and was arrested immediately. More people got angry and gathered in protest."
entries.menuText: "The same soldiers that were supposed to protect Sordland's citizens pointed their guns at us..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stopped there and turned my head..."
entries.dialogueText: I stopped there and turned my head away from Franc.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother -- we had both joined the same human rights group to push for change after the coup of '27. Eventually, I became convinced I wasn't doing enough. So I joined the Red Youth."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother -- we had both joined the same human rights group to push for change after the coup of '27. Eventually, I became convinced I wasn't doing enough. So I joined the Young Sords."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother -- we had both joined the same human rights group to push for change after the coup of '27. But over the next year, the state of Sordland deteriorated. People started picking sides, and I tried to stay away as much as I could."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother. We had both joined the student council to push for change after the coup of '27. Eventually, I became convinced I wasn't doing enough. So I joined the Red Youth."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother. We had both joined the student council to push for change after the coup of '27. Eventually, I became convinced I wasn't doing enough. So I joined the Young Sords."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother -- we had both joined the student council to push for change after the coup of '27. But over the next year, the state of Sordland deteriorated. People started picking sides, and I tried to stay away as much as I could."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: ""Then, one night, it happened. Two..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then, one night, it happened. Two different factions in the army, one of them led by maximist general Luderin and the other by socialist general Rikard, started fighting against each other. It was a bloodbath. Nowhere was safe."
entries.menuText: Tell Franc about the clash between Luderin and Rikard.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So we organised a protest one day..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we organised a protest one day in support of Rikard. In our minds, he was the better of the two and a true socialist."
entries.menuText: "So we organized a protest..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So we organised a protest one day..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we organised a protest one day against Rikard. We were fed up with the army toying with the country again."
entries.menuText: "So we organized a protest..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“That's enough for today.”"
entries.dialogueText: “That's enough for today.”
entries.menuText: “That's enough for today.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“I know I don't understand how easy..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know I don't understand how easy my life is sometimes.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc hesitated, then moved over to..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc hesitated, then moved over to where I was sitting and gave me an awkward pat on the back.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I know I complain sometimes, but m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know I complain sometimes, but my problems are nothing compared to what you went through."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“What problems?”"
entries.dialogueText: “What problems?”
entries.menuText: “What problems?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before Franc could say anything els..."
entries.dialogueText: Before Franc could say anything else, I heard the front door unlock. Deana and Monica's voices and the sounds of rustling shopping bags filled the house.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“I should get some studying done be..."
entries.dialogueText: “I should get some studying done before dinner. But thanks for this, Dad. I mean it.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc went in and dashed upstairs."
entries.dialogueText: Franc went in and dashed upstairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a long sip from my beer, loo..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a long sip from my beer, looking at the city and the now-setting sun.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I hoped that talking to Franc about..."
entries.dialogueText: I hoped that talking to Franc about my past had been the right decision. Part of me felt as if some sort of burden had been lifted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But I had the same nightmares again..."
entries.dialogueText: But I had the same nightmares again that night.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But I had the same nightmares again..."
entries.dialogueText: But I had the same nightmares again that night.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc leaned forward in his chair,..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc leaned forward in his chair, his eyes wide.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: ""I was there with the protesters as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was there with the protesters as they declared martial law. We marched towards them. They threatened to use force, but we stood our ground. So they started beating anyone they saw, including me. The physical wounds took a few weeks to heal, but the mental scars have stayed with me to this day."
entries.menuText: Tell him about the soldiers beating you.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: ""I was there with the protesters as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was there with the protesters as they declared martial law. We marched towards them. They threatened to use force but we stood our ground. "
entries.menuText: Refrain from telling him the brutality.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: ""Seeing the crowd gathering, I knew..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seeing the crowd gathering, I knew something was going to happen. Something bad. I decided that it was impossible to go against armed men and ran away from the scene. Ran away from my friends who were getting arrested and shot to save my own dear life like a coward."
entries.menuText: Tell him that you ran for your life like a coward.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: ""Seeing the crowd gathering, I knew..."
entries.dialogueText: "Seeing the crowd gathering, I knew something was going to happen. Something bad. I decided that it was impossible to go against armed men and departed."
entries.menuText: Refrain from telling him about your quick escape.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was still one of the lucky ones...."
entries.dialogueText: "I was still one of the lucky ones. Some of my friends were shot; many more were arrested. I can't forget the screams to this day."
entries.menuText: "I was lucky..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I still feel my flight was justifi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still feel my flight was justified -- anyone would do the same. No one could sleep that night because of gunshots and sounds of boots. I can't forget the screams to this day."
entries.menuText: "I still feel my flight was justified -- anyone would do the same..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stopped there and turned my head..."
entries.dialogueText: I stopped there and turned my head away from Franc.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I paused for a moment before contin..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused for a moment before continuing.
entries.menuText: Tell him about the girl.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I paused for a moment before contin..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused for a moment before continuing.
entries.menuText: Refrain from telling him about the girl.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I trailed off. There were some thin..."
entries.dialogueText: I trailed off. There were some things my son didn't have to know.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc leaned back in his chair. His..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc leaned back in his chair. His shoulders slumped heavily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc leaned back in his chair. His..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc leaned back in his chair. His shoulders slumped heavily.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc's face had grown pale. He tur..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc's face had grown pale. He turned his eyes away from me.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""People organised protests either f..."
entries.dialogueText: "People organised protests either for or against Rikard. I heard about the clashes the next day. Many of my friends were shot or arrested. I isolated myself for months."
entries.menuText: "I stayed out of it..."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I paused for a moment before contin..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused for a moment before continuing.
entries.menuText: Refrain from telling him about your escape.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I paused for a moment before contin..."
entries.dialogueText: I paused for a moment before continuing.
entries.menuText: Tell him that you ran away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I trailed off, hoping Franc wouldn'..."
entries.dialogueText: I trailed off, hoping Franc wouldn't ask for any more details.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Years later, I still felt that I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Years later, I still felt that I was right. How could mere civilians go against a fully trained army, regardless of how just their cause was?

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc turned away, lost in his own..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc turned away, lost in his own thoughts.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc shifted in his seat, visibly..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc shifted in his seat, visibly uncomfortable.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Sure enough, as soon as Franc glimp..."
entries.dialogueText: Sure enough, as soon as Franc glimpsed the grill and the meat, he stepped outside to join me.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Dad, is there going to be a civil..."
entries.dialogueText: “Dad, is there going to be a civil war in Sordland?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I hope not.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I hope not.”
entries.menuText: “I hope not.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No. I will never let that happen.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No. I will never let that happen.”
entries.menuText: “No. I will never let that happen.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I said nothing and turned my head a..."
entries.dialogueText: I said nothing and turned my head away from him.
entries.menuText: Say nothing and avoid his question.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He let out a sigh."
entries.dialogueText: He let out a sigh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He let out a sigh."
entries.dialogueText: He let out a sigh.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I didn't say bribery was good, did..."
entries.dialogueText: “I didn't say bribery was good, did I? You can always make the moral choice and turn these delicious ribs down..."
entries.menuText: “I didn't say bribery was good, did I? You can always make the moral choice and turn these delicious ribs down...”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc smiled for a second. I turned..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc smiled for a second. I turned to tend to the fire.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Geez, you're barely ever here, and..."
entries.dialogueText: “Geez, you're barely ever here, and when you are you order me around like I'm the butler?”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“As long as it's a request, not an..."
entries.dialogueText: “As long as it's a request, not an order.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "“Let me try again. Franc, it would..."
entries.dialogueText: “Let me try again. Franc, it would be a great help if you would bring the tray from the kitchen. Please."
entries.menuText: Ask again more politely.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“See, was that so hard?”"
entries.dialogueText: “See, was that so hard?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "<shout>“Franc! I said don't make me..."
entries.dialogueText: <shout>“Franc! I said don't make me angry!”</shout>
entries.menuText: “Franc! I said don't make me angry!”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Stop yelling at me. Why are you al..."
entries.dialogueText: “Stop yelling at me. Why are you always like this?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I'm sorry. Work has been overwhelm..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sorry. Work has been overwhelming, but I shouldn't take that out on you."
entries.menuText: “I'm sorry. Work is overwhelming sometimes. I shouldn't have taken it out on you.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Yeah, sure, it's okay. You know, b..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yeah, sure, it's okay. You know, being the president's son isn't exactly a picnic either."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can only imagine. I'm proud of h..."
entries.dialogueText: “I can only imagine. I'm proud of how you've been handling all the changes.”
entries.menuText: “I can only imagine. I'm proud of how well you've been handling everything.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We can talk about it more later. F..."
entries.dialogueText: “We can talk about it more later. For now, will you please go fetch the tray so we can eat?"
entries.menuText: “We can talk about it more later. For now, will you please go fetch the tray so we can eat?”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Aye aye, cap'n.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Aye aye, cap'n.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No. You're my son and I'm asking y..."
entries.dialogueText: “No. You're my son and I'm asking you. Can you bring the tray now, please?”
entries.menuText: “No. You're my son and I'm asking you. Can you bring the tray now, please?”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Ah. *Please*. The magic word.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Ah. *Please*. The magic word.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Fine, I'll be back.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Fine, I'll be back.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Damn your generation. You are all..."
entries.dialogueText: “Damn your generation. You are all the same. Weak.”
entries.menuText: “Damn your generation. You are all the same. Weak.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Weak?! Dad, can't you see you're n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Weak?! Dad, can't you see you're not the only one having a hard time here?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""You never even asked me how it fee..."
entries.dialogueText: "You never even asked me how it feels -- being treated differently in school, everyone asking me about the riots all the time, not even being able to take a piss without those guards following me..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Oh, cry me a river. Grow a spine a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Oh, cry me a river. Grow a spine and make something of yourself.”
entries.menuText: “Oh, cry me a river. Grow a spine and make something of yourself.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“I'm sorry for being spineless, oka..."
entries.dialogueText: “I'm sorry for being spineless, okay? Are you happy now? I'll get your goddamn tray."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc returned with a tray large en..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc returned with a tray large enough to hold all the meat and vegetables. He shoved it at me.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“I'm going to my room.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I'm going to my room.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He ran inside the house before I co..."
entries.dialogueText: He ran inside the house before I could say anything. The door slammed behind him.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a long sip from my beer."
entries.dialogueText: I took a long sip from my beer.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I've warned you. Shut up and do as..."
entries.dialogueText: “I've warned you. Shut up and do as I say -- or else.”
entries.menuText: “I've warned you. Shut up and do as I say -- or else.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Or else what? You're going to slap..."
entries.dialogueText: “Or else what? You're going to slap me? Beat me?”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Fine. I'll go get your goddamn tra..."
entries.dialogueText: “Fine. I'll go get your goddamn tray."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Alright. I'll be upstairs until di..."
entries.dialogueText: “Alright. I'll be upstairs until dinner.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Yes, Father.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, Father.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“You will have to go through my sec..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will have to go through my secretary first.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed and started making his w..."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed and started making his way to the kitchen.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“One more thing, though -- I know y..."
entries.dialogueText: “One more thing, though -- I know you joined the Young Sords back then. Do you mind if I ask why?”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“One more thing, though -- I know t..."
entries.dialogueText: “One more thing, though -- I know that you joined Red Youth back then. Do you mind if I ask why?”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“One more thing, though -- I know t..."
entries.dialogueText: “One more thing, though -- I know that you managed to not take any sides. Do you mind if I ask why?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, I do mind. I don't want to ta..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, I do mind. I don't want to talk about it.”
entries.menuText: “Yes, I do mind. I don't want to talk about it.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Sordland was under attack by commu..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sordland was under attack by communists and I had to defend the country.”
entries.menuText: “Sordland was under attack by communists and I had to defend the country.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Okay. I was just curious, that's a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Okay. I was just curious, that's all.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc raised his eyebrows, his curi..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc raised his eyebrows, his curiosity still not satisfied. But sensing my reluctance to go on, he simply nodded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I had to survive somehow in that e..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had to survive somehow in that environment and I made a choice.”
entries.menuText: “I had to survive somehow in that environment and I made a choice.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, I do mind. I don't want to ta..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, I do mind. I don't want to talk about it.”
entries.menuText: “Yes, I do mind. I don't want to talk about it.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Okay. I was just curious, that's a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Okay. I was just curious, that's all.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“A communist revolution for Sordlan..."
entries.dialogueText: “A communist revolution for Sordland was and still is the only way.”
entries.menuText: “A communist revolution for Sordland was and still is the only way.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc raised his eyebrows, his curi..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc raised his eyebrows, his curiosity still not satisfied. But sensing my reluctance to go on, he simply nodded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I had to survive somehow in that e..."
entries.dialogueText: “I had to survive somehow in that environment, and I made a choice.”
entries.menuText: “I had to survive somehow in that environment, and I made a choice.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes, I do mind. I don't want to ta..."
entries.dialogueText: “Yes, I do mind. I don't want to talk about it.”
entries.menuText: “Yes, I do mind. I don't want to talk about it.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Okay. I was just curious, that's a..."
entries.dialogueText: “Okay. I was just curious, that's all.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc raised his eyebrows, his curi..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc raised his eyebrows, his curiosity still not satisfied. But sensing my reluctance to go on, he simply nodded.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I didn't want to be part of the vi..."
entries.dialogueText: “I didn't want to be part of the violence.”
entries.menuText: “I didn't want to be part of the violence."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“They are two sides of the same coi..."
entries.dialogueText: “They are two sides of the same coin.”
entries.menuText: “They are two sides of the same coin.”

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Sorry for bombarding you with ques..."
entries.dialogueText: “Sorry for bombarding you with questions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Don't act like you've done anythin..."
entries.dialogueText: “Don't act like you've done anything special, Franc.”
entries.menuText: “Don't act like you've done something special, Franc.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gave me a blank stare and then t..."
entries.dialogueText: He gave me a blank stare and then turned his eyes away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wasn't sure how he felt about me..."
entries.dialogueText: I wasn't sure how he felt about me at the moment. But I did know how he felt about barbecued ribs. Our cook had left some marinating in the refrigerator.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So, you've decided to speak to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, you've decided to speak to me again?"
entries.menuText: "So, you've finally decided to speak to me again?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Well, look who's finally out of hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, look who's finally out of his room."
entries.menuText: "Well, look who's finally out of his room."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Come to spend some quality time wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come to spend some quality time with your old man, have you?"
entries.menuText: "Come to spend some quality time with your old man, have you?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""You should talk, Dad. I never see..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should talk, Dad. I never see you at home anymore."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Sure, if you can spare a few minut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, if you can spare a few minutes out of your busy schedule."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sorry, I know I haven't been a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, I know I haven't been around very often lately. But I'm happy to see you now."
entries.menuText: "I'm sorry, I know I haven't been around very often lately. But I'm happy to see you now."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Look, son, I'm preoccupied with ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look, son, I'm preoccupied with matters of national importance."
entries.menuText: "Look, son, I'm preoccupied with matters of national importance."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Yes, Mr. President. Whatever you s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President. Whatever you say, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""But right now, nothing's more impo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But right now, nothing's more important than these ribs."
entries.menuText: "But right now, nothing's more important than these ribs."

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""It's okay. I know you've got the m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's okay. I know you've got the most stressful job in the country. And you've got to feed your family on top of it all...”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We both chuckled. I turned to tend..."
entries.dialogueText: We both chuckled. I turned to tend to the fire.

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Like at dinner that night after th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like at dinner that night after the ball. You told me everything was under control, but it wasn't, was it?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""I know what happened in the '20s -..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know what happened in the '20s -- we learned all about it in school. Now, with the protests and the riots, is it going to be the same thing?"

entries.speaker: Franc
entries.title: Franc: ""Like at dinner that night after th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like at dinner that night after the ball. Maybe I shouldn't have brought it up in front of Deana, but I was right, wasn't I? It's bad."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The shock and grief on the faces of..."
entries.dialogueText: The shock and grief on the faces of fathers, mothers and orphaned children.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother -- we had both joined the same political debate group to push for change after the coup of '27. But over the next year, the state of Sordland deteriorated. People started picking sides, and I tried to stay away as much as I could."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother -- we had both joined the same political debate group to push for change after the coup of '27. Eventually, I became convinced I wasn't doing enough. So I joined the Young Sords."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was right after I met your moth..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was right after I met your mother -- we had both joined the same political debate group to push for change after the coup of '27. Eventually, I became convinced I wasn't doing enough. So I joined the Red Youth."
entries.menuText: "It was right after I met your mother..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was horrible. They were waiting..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was horrible. They were waiting for us. Soldiers started beating and shooting at everyone, and plowing their tanks into the crowd. Amid the chaos, there was this girl. I never forgot her face. I tried to save her, but I couldn't reach her in time..."
entries.menuText: "It was horrible..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It was horrible. They were waiting..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was horrible. They were waiting for us. Everything plunged into chaos. Soldiers started beating and shooting at everyone...."
entries.menuText: "It was horrible..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Soldiers were waiting for us. I kn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Soldiers were waiting for us. I knew something was going to happen. Something bad. I decided that it was impossible to go against armed men and ran away from the scene."
entries.menuText: "Soldiers were waiting for us..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We were ready to face them. I had..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were ready to face them. I had no time for bad feelings, they rushed at us. We stood and fought but many were arrested and shot..."
entries.menuText: "We were ready to face them..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I was barely older than you are no..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was barely older than you are now, studying history at the Deyr University of Culture. I was a freshman. Excited and young."
entries.menuText: "I was barely older than you are now..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Franc kept listening, a shocked loo..."
entries.dialogueText: Franc kept listening, a shocked look on his face.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm here to listen to them, no mat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm here to listen to them, no matter what they are."
entries.menuText: "I'm here to listen to them, no matter what they are."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're damn right. Your generation..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're damn right. Your generation will never understand."
entries.menuText: "You're damn right. Your generation will never understand."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I still feel my flight was shamefu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still feel my flight was shameful -- I should have stood my ground. No one could sleep that night because of gunshots and sounds of boots. I can't forget the screams to this day."
entries.menuText: "I still feel my flight was shameful -- I should have stood my ground..."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I tried my best to stay strong. So..."
entries.dialogueText: "I tried my best to stay strong. Some of my friends were shot; many more were arrested. I can't forget the screams to this day. But I'm proud not to have faltered."
entries.menuText: "I stayed strong..."

entries.speaker: Franc
Franc
entries.title: Franc: "“Looks like it.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Looks like it.”
